History

A website of the Privatzimmer Trainer was not found. PocketAustria lists a guesthouse Privatzimmer Trainer, Hinterthiersee 6, and names the postcode 6330 Thiersee. FreizeitMonster names a pension in Thiersee at the address Hinterthiersee 6, 6335 Thiersee. The data set uses 6335, Hinterthiersee 6 and the telephone number +43 5376 5521. This telephone number is not written out again on the two directory extracts. A year of construction, the names of the landlords and a room description are missing. PocketAustria names as nearby entries the Ferienwohnung Kranzbichl and the Ayurveda Hotel Sonnhof. Those are neighbours in the directory, not services of this room. Older sentences about a lake, a breakfast or a family guest parlour are not documented.

The street Hinterthiersee 6 in Thiersee is the address that matches; the postcode varies between 6330 and 6335. PocketAustria names the bus stops Thiersee Neubänken at 336 metres, Hinterthiersee Dorf at 345 metres and Thiersee Hinteres Mitterland at 1.1 kilometres. A line number is missing.

Tips

Prices, board, Wi-Fi and the question of whether the place is still let at all cannot be answered from the directories. An enquiry can try the number carried in the data set, +43 5376 5521. Until then the entry remains proof of an address and not a fully worked-out accommodation description.
